reason: Both propose essentially the same NH3-annealing/N-doping intervention, mechanism, evidence, and untreated-control experiment, while largely extrapolating an existing fuel-cell result to exhaust catalysis without establishing N stability in hot oxidizing H2O/NO feeds. Neither provides quantitative processing or performance criteria, and both lack an inert-gas annealed control needed to distinguish nitrogen effects from annealing-induced segregation or sintering.
